Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick reply and details. Short answers and a proposed implementation checklist below. I will run the kickoff and own the project timeline.

API key delivery models (options — pick one):
A) Redwood seeds an initial staging admin key into a temporary service account we create in your staging workspace. Key will be rotated after handoff.
B) Helix generates keys in your KMS/HSM and provides us an asymmetric public key (we register key material and integrate via our customer KMS flow). This is the recommended path for prod.

Roles and scopes (defaults + customization):
- admin: full workspace control, key management, rollout controls.
- developer: model invocation, logs access, limited rollout.
- observer: metrics and logs read-only.
We can add custom roles; please provide a short matrix if you need custom perms.

Proposed 2-week activation sprint (high level):
- Day 0 (Wed 7/21): Kickoff call (30m discovery + 30m tech) — confirm primary contacts and deliverables.
- Day 1-2: Create staging workspace, seed admin key (option A) OR start KMS intake (option B).
- Day 3-5: Customer populates invite CSV and we send invites for initial users (6 accounts).
- Week 2: Integration testing, role adjustments, and sign-off on production readiness.

Pre-kickoff checklist for Helix (please supply before Wed):
- Marco: preferred service-account name and any naming conventions.
- IP allowlist ranges (for callbacks) or proxy egress details.
- A short user-role matrix for the first 6 accounts (CSV attached).

Attachments: Helix-implementation-milestones.xlsx (detailed timeline), admin-invite-template.csv (format for invites).

If Helix prefers option B for production KMS we will create a KMS intake form after staging is validated.

I'll send a calendar invite for Wed 7/21 10:00am PT.

Warmly,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
